description: F7 part 2 golden, rule 11: the B10 dark / midpoint venue model (API_TRADING.md section 2.17; iap.execution.dark and the dark-first rule of iap.execution.replay are the reference; every dark fill is MODELLED, not measured). scalar: sigmoid, dark_features ([lit_volume, spread_ticks, qty, queue_ahead]), p_fill per model, midpoint_ticks ([bid, ask, side]), the stateless dark_pretrade_check (the Rust risk engine owns the controls, F8; this is the replay-path mirror) and the B6 fill type of a dark_midpoint fill. scenarios: ExecutionReplay with dark_first parents over the golden stream and the real slice; fills rows = the 12 pinned fields + is_dark (provenance == dark_midpoint); children rows = the 12 pinned fields + venue_type, dark_outcome, dark_u, dark_p_fill; parent reports carry the dark_* accounting. `models` holds every DarkFillModel document the parents name.
parity: canonical JSON bytes of `expected` (sorted keys, no whitespace, Python float repr) must equal the C++ port's canonical bytes; `expected_tol` (when present) is compared to `tolerance`

multi7.label: modelled, not measured
multi7.model: logistic midpoint fill probability within horizon (iap.execution.dark)
multi7.proxy: Nasdaq ITCH non-displayed prints ('P' TRADE messages that are not the print of the EXECUTE immediately before them on the same venue book at the same exchange_ts) whose price lies strictly inside the displayed best bid / ask at the time of the print; the label of a probe (t, q) is 'inside-spread hidden volume in [t, t + horizon) >= q'; the lit-volume feature is the displayed EXECUTE volume in [t - horizon, t); no dark-pool data was used (none is free)
multi7.source: multi7: eq_20190130.normalized.iap1, eq_20190327.normalized.iap1, eq_20190730.normalized.iap1, eq_20190830.normalized.iap1, eq_20191030.normalized.iap1, eq_20191230.normalized.iap1, eq_20200130.normalized.iap1
